english: 12-16. Holy rites and Yāgas performed with Vedic Mantras and offerings of Havis are called Vaidikī Bhakti. Agnihotra should be performed during the new-moon and full-moon days. All rites associated with Yajñas intended for Rudra should be carried out (rites such as—feeding, giving of monetary gifts, Puroḍāśa offerings, holy rites, sacrificial operation, drinking of Soma, chanting of the Mantras from the Ṛg, Yajus and Sāma Vedas, recitation of the Saṃhitā texts etc.). What is performed thus is proclaimed as Vaidikī Bhakti. All the rites performed with Agni, Earth, Wind, Ether, Moon and Sun in view will be Daivika (‘pertaining to Devas’). O sage, Ādhyātmikī Rudra Bhakti is of two types.
